data.description: The Cooking Workbench is the cooking station for advanced recipes, and it has 61 of them: bread, pies and teas need no blueprint, while low grade fuel, gunpowder, [explosives](/items/explosives) and some ammo do. Craft one at a tier 2 workbench for 200 frags, 200 stones and 100 wood. Research it for 40 [scrap](/items/scrap), or unlock it on the tier 2 tech tree past the [Large Furnace](/items/large-furnace) for 10 [blueprint pages](/items/blueprint-page) total. Loot drops are rare, around 1% at best.
data.name: Cooking Workbench
